decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy sits close to the firm's psychiatric core, is reimbursable, and was promoted to the home page in 2024, so its value is being confirmed and the option is worth keeping.
Senior living counseling costs little to run, has stayed on the home page for two years, and supports demand for the firm's eldercare facilities, so there is no reason to abandon it.

The sheltered workshop retail shop gained home page visibility in 2024 and uses existing workshop production, so it is a cheap option with improving signals despite the carpentry workshop being dropped.
Meal delivery launched only in 2024, so its prospects are still uncertain, and because it complements eldercare at modest cost the option should be kept open until results show more.
